permitted_use: Use the 30 rows as a source-located lead set for future corpus review.
Use semantic-domain tags as provisional indexing metadata.
Keep whole-word signs outside the 26 x 8 syllabic CV count.
forbidden_use: Do not claim a complete logograph corpus.
Do not claim reviewed glyph-shape interpretation.
Do not treat unknown or ambiguous glosses as resolved lexical evidence.
article_implication: Article 4 can argue that a 30-item logograph lead set is auditable as a corpus-building seed, but it cannot claim a complete logograph corpus, reviewed glyph inventory, or public source-image release.
